entities.summary: Mark Andre is a French composer living in Germany. He was known as "Marc André", his birth name, until 2007, when he formally revised the spelling. He lives in Berlin. Andre's compositions durch (2006), ..auf.. III (2007), and Wunderzaichen (2014) received multiple votes in a 2017 Classic Voice poll of the greatest works of art music since 2000. Mark Andre was a heads of state & government from Paris (b. 1964-05-10, Paris). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
